_comment: T11 / AK-13 regression cases. Each bundle is frozen once by backend/scripts/freeze_regression.py --freeze and never regenerated by make sync (ADR-0006 Nr. 3). The test rebuilds each case and requires a byte-identical export.

cases.name: rg01_baseline
cases.pins: full pipeline on the baseline scenario: emulation, observation (partial window), forward/target-guided fixture sweeps, merge, stability re-run, evaluation of all three spaces

cases.name: rg02_recovery
cases.pins: recovery variant with an approved APPLY_APPROVAL (role:supervisor) and the resulting reference trajectory

cases.name: rg03_sparse_schedule
cases.pins: explicit sweep schedule [1, 3, 5]: NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_TICK between sweeps, M03 Ω_R INPUT_MISSING, evaluation PARTIAL

cases.name: rg04_no_engine
cases.pins: LOCAL adapter without engine (DEP-02): BLOCKED sweeps with ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE, nothing reconstructed, SYNTHETIC status records
